5) the actor m-a-r-k-e-d the i-c-c m-a-t-t-e-r as c-l-o-s-e-d after a-s-s-e-m-b-l-i-n-g a s-e-a-l-e-d e-x-h-i-b-i-t and left an a-r-c-h-i-v-e d-u-m-p while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y h-a-s-h
